footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to GXO: after $4.0M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 12.5% to $13.2B in 2025. Operating income rose 12.4% to $245M, a 1.9% margin.
Net income fell 76.1% to $32.0M, or $0.28 per share. Operating cash flow was $434M and free cash flow $110M, versus $190M; GXO returned $200M through buybacks.
sources: GXO Logistics, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
